GetMonitorList.description: Gets a list of connected monitors and information about them.

OpenVideoMixProjector.description: Opens a projector for a specific output video mix.

fields.name: monitorIndex
fields.description: Monitor index, use `GetMonitorList` to obtain index

fields.name: projectorGeometry
fields.description: Size/Position data for a windowed projector, in Qt Base64 encoded format. Mutually exclusive with `monitorIndex`

fields.name: sourceName
fields.description: Name of the source to open a projector for

fields.name: sourceUuid
fields.description: UUID of the source to open a projector for
